title: Give Thanks to the Lord, for He Is Good

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:1 (ESV): "Praise the Lord! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good,"

questions.question: For his steadfast love endures how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:1 (ESV): "for his steadfast love endures forever!"

questions.question: Who can utter the mighty deeds of the Lord, or declare all his what?
Blessed are they who observe justice, who do righteousness when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:3 (ESV): "Blessed are they who observe justice, who do righteousness at all times!"

questions.question: Remember me, O Lord, when you show favor to your people; help me when you do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:4 (ESV): "...help me when you save them,"

questions.question: Both we and our fathers have sinned; we have committed iniquity; we have done what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:6 (ESV): "...we have committed iniquity; we have done wickedness."

questions.question: Our fathers, when they were in Egypt, did not consider your wondrous works; they rebelled by the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:7 (ESV): "...but they rebelled by the sea, at the Red Sea."

questions.question: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his mighty what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:8 (ESV): "...that he might make known his mighty power."

questions.question: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it became dry, and he led them through the deep as through a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:9 (ESV): "...and he led them through the deep as through a desert."

questions.question: So he saved them from the hand of the foe and redeemed them from the power of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:10 (ESV): "...and redeemed them from the power of the enemy."

questions.question: They made a calf in Horeb and worshiped a metal image. They exchanged the glory of God for the image of an ox that eats what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:20 (ESV): "They exchanged the glory of God for the image of an ox that eats grass."

questions.question: They invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people ate and bowed down to their gods. So Israel yoked himself to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:28 (ESV): "So Israel yoked himself to Baal of Peor..."

questions.question: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:30 (ESV): "Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was stayed."

questions.question: They angered him at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with whom on their account?
questions.explanation: Psalm 106:32 (ESV): "...and it went ill with Moses on their account,"

questions.question: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your what?

key_verse_text: Praise the Lord! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!
